source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), pick one option for this model. It keeps that ability until your next [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase) begins. Options are **[Fanatical Devotion](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.thulia-ghuld.fanatical-devotion)**, **[Adaptive Tactics](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.thulia-ghuld.adaptive-tactics)** or **[The Fires of Mars](vsdata:ability/adeptus-mechanicus.thulia-ghuld.the-fires-of-mars)**.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
